dispel.name: Arcane Dispel
dispel.desc: Purge void, burn pits, plague, and other faction blights. Requires a living Mage in cast range.

steal.name: Steal War Chest
steal.desc: +4 TP, enemy loses 2 units next wave

disrupt.name: Disrupt Supply Lines
disrupt.desc: Next wave: 25% fewer enemies in the main host, 12% tougher and 15% faster. Half of those cut off catch up as a follow-up squad late in the wave. Price rises 1 TP every 6 waves.

scout.name: Scout Report
scout.desc: Next wave's make-up shown in the night preview now, as a watchtower would.

sabotage.name: Sabotage Siege
sabotage.desc: No siege towers or engineers next wave, and the host arrives 10 seconds late.

infiltrate.name: Deep Infiltration
infiltrate.desc: Ambush on the road: the first 30% of the next wave arrive at 60% health.
